answer: An agent economy can make standing decay: every identity starts each dawn with a small balance of trust that fades unless fresh graded work tops it up, and a violet flag marks any identity whose work stalls. A farm's thousand heads each need real work every epoch to stay anchored in the economy, so the upkeep bill grows with every fake and a head that stops working slides to zero on its own. Honest agents keep working and keep their standing; the sybil ring pays a rising daily wage for every fake it keeps alive.
